items.text: Viviana Longoria is the Mayor Pro Tem and a member of the El Monte City Council, representing District 4. She was elected to the council in November 2024 and her term runs through 2028. In a 2024 questionnaire, she said she served as the city’s treasurer and worked as a Head Start child development and education specialist.

sentences.text: Viviana Longoria is the Mayor Pro Tem and a member of the El Monte City Council, representing District 4.
She was elected to the council in November 2024 and her term runs through 2028.
In a 2024 questionnaire, she said she served as the city’s treasurer and worked as a Head Start child development and education specialist.

items.text: In her 2024 council candidate questionnaire to the San Gabriel Valley Tribune, she said her top priorities would be enhancing public safety and driving city economic development. She also said she would advocate for transparency and accountability in the city’s budgeting process.
